name: omnilab/pdb
description: Omnilab PDB: an entry of the Protein Data Bank by its PDB id through RCSB PDB's GraphQL Data API - its title, keywords, method, resolution, weight, dates, primary citation and authors, its polymer entities and ligands, an image of its assembly; the UniProt proteins of its chains, their organisms and its ligands (ChEBI, PubChem or InChIKey) as related things, never its identifiers; a removed entry's only replacement - and RCSB's full-text search, no key needed.
